label: eUSD launch, the first US-chartered bank stablecoin (Telcoin/Nebraska)
Telcoin Wallet opens US individual bank accounts tied to eUSD balances
note: 2026-06-23: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank said US-resident users can open an individual account in the latest Telcoin Wallet release that is directly tied to their eUSD balance; yield on eUSD balances and debit cards were announced for later point releases.
